nodes.title: ADR 0013: Manage schedules with native systemd timers
ADR 0048: Copy App process and schedule definitions into AppInstances
ADR 0038: Cascade AppInstance removal through processes and schedules

description:
The agent can declare the processes and schedules intended for development or production on an App without changing any existing instance’s runtime.

## Scope

* In: App-owned process and schedule definition storage, validation, Gateway CRUD, and App-definition documentation.
* Out: runtime installation, live inheritance, copying candidate overrides, instance specification edits, deployment steps, SDK, and CLI.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `/apps/{app}/process-definitions` and `/apps/{app}/schedule-definitions` expose GET list, POST create, GET item, PUT replacement, and DELETE item using definition UUIDs; each name is unique within its App and definition kind. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Api/AppRuntimeDefinitionsTest.php`.
- [ ] Each definition has a nonempty `environments` array containing unique `development` or `production` values; process `spec` uses the accepted process runtime fields without target, start state, or host execution identity, and schedule `spec` contains command, calendar, and timeout under the Schedule validation limits. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Domain/AppRuntimeDefinitionTest.php`.
- [ ] Creating, replacing, or deleting a definition makes no remote call and changes no Process, Schedule, selected release, or desired runtime state; removing an AppInstance preserves definitions and unrelated instance copies. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Domain/AppRuntimeDefinitionTest.php`.
- [ ] The API uses the existing App-operation authorization boundary, rejects unknown or duplicate JSON members and cross-App definition IDs, and keeps command content out of lists, Activity, generic errors, and Doctor diagnostics. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Api/AppRuntimeDefinitionsTest.php`.
- [ ] Deleting an otherwise removable App deletes its own definitions; Doctor’s model coverage classifies definition records as configuration without remote runtime artifacts. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Domain/AppRuntimeDefinitionTest.php` and `apps/gateway/tests/Unit/Architecture/DoctorModelCoverageTest.php`.
- [ ] Maintained documentation describes definition fields, applicability, ownership, and independent instance copies, and generated context is current. Proof: `composer docs-lint`.
- [ ] Changed project checks and repository suites pass. Proof: `cd apps/gateway && composer check`, and all five full no-TIA CI suites on the submitted candidate, plus focused affected Pest tests locally.
title: Manage reusable App process and schedule definitions
